class.name: IfcSchedulingTime
class.brief_description: IfcSchedulingTime is the abstract supertype of entities that capture time-related information of processes. HISTORY: New entity in IFC2x4.

members.member: Optional name for the time definition.
Specifies the origin of the scheduling time entity. It currently differentiates between predicted, simulated, measured, and user defined values.
Value of the data origin if DataOrigin attribute is USERDEFINED.
